info.description:
Global fire intelligence platform API

Access real-time fire detection data from NASA FIRMS satellites and manage
your monitored locations programmatically.

## Authentication

All requests require an API key in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer fp_your_api_key_here
```

Get your API key from your FirePing dashboard.
